scope: Epic 5 — A settings screen you can navigate, trust, and verify
rationale: P0 coverage is 100% and overall coverage is 91% (minimum: 80%), but P1 coverage is 86% (target: 90%). Coverage percentages are unchanged from 2026-08-26; the gate rules score coverage, not reliability, and the integration layer carrying most of this evidence was found to be order-dependent and non-deterministic.

uncovered_requirements.gap: #tab-{slug} deep link asserted as a source substring, never exercised
keyboard operation and focus ring asserted as strings in JS/CSS source

findings.summary: Integration suite is order-dependent and non-deterministic: 40 failures in a full run vs 0 for the same Epic 5 files in isolation, with a different failing set each run. Cause already tracked as retro action 4 (DB isolation binding, deferred since 3.13.0).

Three SettingsTabsIntegrationTest assertions were stale against Epic 6's fifth Field mapping tab, leaving 5.1-AC5 and 5.1-AC6 evidence red on the branch. Arity updated 4->5 and 3->4; file now 19/19 green, phpcs clean.
Context ID parameter name confirmed as include_contexts (gh#46, 2026-08-25). Residual: getGroupedProducts acceptance, and the stale unverified marker at sprint-status.yaml:113.
No written decision on the source-string assertion ceiling for 5.1-AC4/AC6 (retro action 5). Sole reason P1 sits at 86%.

recommendations: Fix the integration-suite DB isolation binding (retro action 4) — blocking, before Epic 6 grows the suite further.
Add an integration job to required CI; the unit-only pipeline let a red integration suite sit undetected on the branch.
Record the 5.1-AC4/AC6 ceiling decision, or extract the tab controller so those branches become unit-testable.
Clear or narrow the sprint-status.yaml:113 Context ID marker.
scope_note: Epic 5 only. Epic 6 (stories 6.1-6.5) has landed on this branch, has had no traceability run and holds no gate. Some full-run integration failures observed here are in Epic 6 files and are unexamined by this trace.
